summary_en: This study tests cemiplimab, given with platinum chemotherapy (cisplatin or carboplatin), docetaxel (or paclitaxel if docetaxel cannot be used), and cetuximab, before surgery in people with resectable, locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. Chemotherapy and cemiplimab are given in cycles over several weeks, with cetuximab given weekly for about 10 weeks, and surgery follows about 28 days (plus or minus 7 days) after the third cycle. The record does not state a main outcome measure; the listed phase is Phase 1.
summary_es: Este estudio prueba cemiplimab, administrado con quimioterapia a base de platino (cisplatino o carboplatino), docetaxel (o paclitaxel si no se puede usar docetaxel) y cetuximab, antes de la cirugía en personas con carcinoma de células escamosas de cabeza y cuello, localmente avanzado y resecable. La quimioterapia y el cemiplimab se administran en ciclos durante varias semanas, el cetuximab se administra cada semana durante unas 10 semanas, y la cirugía se realiza unos 28 días (más o menos 7 días) después del tercer ciclo. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; la fase indicada es la Fase 1.
who_for: Squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck, confirmed by tissue or cell testing
Locally advanced disease with no distant spread, where standard care would be surgery then radiation with or without chemotherapy
Disease must be removable by surgery, and the patient must be a surgical candidate
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status below 1
Adequate blood counts, kidney function and liver function
not_for: Prior radiation or systemic therapy for head and neck cancer
Oral cavity cancer that cannot be removed by surgery
Autoimmune or inflammatory disorder treated with steroids or immunomodulators in the past 5 years, with listed exceptions
Immune-related pneumonitis in the past 5 years, or interstitial lung disease
Uncontrolled HIV, hepatitis B or hepatitis C, or immunodeficiency
cancer_types: head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
